description: Secondary progressions (day-for-a-year) and solar-arc directions of a natal chart to a target date. Returns, per body, the secondary-progressed longitude and the solar-arc-directed longitude, plus the solar arc itself. Longitudes only (no houses), so no birthplace is needed.

date.description: UTC date-time, ISO 8601, e.g. 1990-06-10T14:30:00Z. Convert local birth time to UTC first.

target_date.description: UTC ISO date to progress/direct to (convert from local first)

name: progressions
